title: Math Antics - Adding and Subtracting Fractions
subject: Mathematics
summary: Math Antics teaches how to add and subtract fractions with clear, step-by-step instructions. Covers common denominators, simplifying, and mixed numbers for Grade 4 learners.

title: Math Antics - Simplifying Fractions
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn how to simplify fractions by finding greatest common factors. Math Antics breaks down the procedure with visual models and practice examples for Grade 4 students.

title: What On Earth: Crash Course Kids #10.1
subject: Science
summary: Sabrina explains how Earth's four spheres - geosphere, biosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere - interact with each other. NGSS-aligned content for upper elementary science.

title: How Your Brain Works? - The Dr. Binocs Show
subject: Science
summary: Dr. Binocs explains how the brain works in simple terms. Covers brain parts, neurons, and how we think, learn, and remember. Fascinating biology for Grade 4 students.

title: Basic multiplication | Multiplication and division | Khan Academy
subject: Mathematics
summary: Sal Khan introduces multiplication as groups of objects. This foundational lesson helps Grade 4 students understand the meaning behind multiplication before memorizing tables.

title: Bones | The Dr. Binocs Show | Learn Videos For Kids
subject: Science
summary: Dr. Binocs explains every detail about human bones - their forms, names, and functions. Grade 4 students learn about the skeletal system through engaging animation.

title: How To Draw A Cute Hawaiian Shave Ice
subject: Art
summary: Learn to draw a cute Hawaiian shave ice with colorful toppings. A fun art lesson that teaches shading, color blending, and creative food illustration for Grade 4 artists.

title: The Amazing Science of Balloons | SciShow Kids Compilation
subject: Science
summary: Jessi and friends learn about electricity, pressure, and chemical reactions from balloon science experiments. Covers static electricity, balloon rockets, and more for Grade 4.

title: Math Antics - Long Division
subject: Mathematics
summary: Math Antics teaches long division step by step. Learn to divide multi-digit dividends by one-digit divisors using the standard long division algorithm.

title: Math Antics - Long Division with 2-Digit Divisors
subject: Mathematics
summary: Continue learning long division with two-digit divisors. Math Antics explains estimation, trial quotients, and checking answers with multiplication.

title: Math Antics - Factors and Multiples
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn the difference between factors and multiples. Find all factor pairs of a number and identify multiples of a number. Essential for fraction work.

title: Math Antics - Prime Factorization
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to break down composite numbers into their prime factors using factor trees. Prime factorization is the foundation for finding GCF and LCM.

title: The Multiplying Fractions Song | By Whole Numbers
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to multiply a fraction by a whole number. Understand that 3 x 1/4 means three groups of one-fourth, which equals three-fourths.

title: The Decimal Place Value Song | Tenths and Hundredths
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about decimal place value - tenths and hundredths. Understand that decimals are another way to write fractions with denominators of 10 or 100.

title: The Comparing Decimals Song | Greater Than, Less Than
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to compare decimals using place value. Compare tenths first, then hundredths if needed. Use greater than, less than, and equal to symbols correctly.

title: The Angle Song | Acute, Right, Obtuse, Straight
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about different types of angles - acute (less than 90), right (exactly 90), obtuse (more than 90), and straight (exactly 180). Measure angles with a protractor.

title: The Lines Song | Parallel, Perpendicular, Intersecting
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about parallel lines (never meet), perpendicular lines (meet at 90 degrees), and intersecting lines (cross at any angle). Identify lines in real-world objects.

title: The Symmetry Song | Lines of Symmetry
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about lines of symmetry - imaginary lines that divide a shape into two matching halves. Find lines of symmetry in letters, shapes, and real-world objects.

title: The Metric System Song | Meters, Liters, Grams
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn the metric system units for length (meters), volume (liters), and mass (grams). Understand prefixes like kilo-, centi-, and milli- and how they change unit size.

title: The Customary Units Song | Inches, Feet, Yards, Miles
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn customary units of measurement for length, weight, and capacity. Inches, feet, yards, miles, ounces, pounds, cups, pints, quarts, and gallons.

title: The Prepositions Song | Location Words
subject: English
summary: Learn about prepositions - words that show the relationship between a noun and other words in a sentence. Above, below, between, through, during, and more.

title: The Conjunctions Song | FANBOYS
subject: English
summary: Learn the coordinating conjunctions using FANBOYS - For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So. Use conjunctions to join words, phrases, and clauses in sentences.

title: The Interjections Song | Wow! Ouch! Hey!
subject: English
summary: Learn about interjections - words that express strong emotion. Wow! Ouch! Hey! Hurray! Understand how interjections add feeling and excitement to writing.

title: The Idioms Song | Figurative Language
subject: English
summary: Learn common idioms like 'it's raining cats and dogs' and 'break a leg.' Understand that idioms are phrases that don't mean what the words literally say.

title: The Alliteration Song | Tongue Twisters
subject: English
summary: Learn about alliteration - the repetition of the same beginning sound in nearby words. Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers! Create your own alliterative phrases.

title: The Onomatopoeia Song | Sound Words
subject: English
summary: Learn about onomatopoeia - words that imitate sounds. Buzz, hiss, pop, crash, bang! Understand how onomatopoeia brings writing to life with sound.

title: The Personification Song | Giving Human Traits to Objects
subject: English
summary: Learn about personification - giving human qualities to non-human things. The wind whispered through the trees. The sun smiled down on us.

title: The Hyperbole Song | Exaggeration for Effect
subject: English
summary: Learn about hyperbole - extreme exaggeration used for emphasis or humor. I'm so hungry I could eat a horse! Understand when and why writers use hyperbole.

title: The Summary Song | Summarizing a Text
subject: English
summary: Learn to write a summary - a brief retelling of the main ideas of a text. Include only the most important information and leave out unnecessary details.

title: The Inference Song | Reading Between the Lines
subject: English
summary: Learn to make inferences by reading between the lines. Use text evidence and background knowledge to draw conclusions that the author doesn't directly state.
